name: yao_open_prompts_prompts
description: Reusable prompt pack derived from the yao_open_prompts capability.

prompts.name: task_description_prompt
prompts.template: Generate a detailed and clear AI prompt for the following task: {user_intent}. Include relevant context: {context}. Use {language_preference} language.
prompts.use_case: Generating task-oriented AI prompts for business and marketing campaigns.

prompts.name: marketing_campaign_prompt
prompts.template: Create a persuasive marketing prompt targeting: {user_intent}. Background details: {context}. Provide output in {language_preference}.
prompts.use_case: Creating educational content prompts to aid learning and teaching.

prompts.name: content_creation_prompt
prompts.template: Write an engaging content creation AI prompt focusing on: {user_intent}. Include context: {context}. Output language: {language_preference}.
prompts.use_case: Formulating content creation prompts for writing, social media, or blogs.

prompts.name: learning_assistance_prompt
prompts.template: Develop an instructional AI prompt to assist with learning: {user_intent}. Relevant info: {context}. Language preference: {language_preference}.
prompts.use_case: Everyday scenario prompts to improve daily productivity and workflows.
